title: SOC2 query sandbox: control-owner mapping & quick Qs
content:
Purpose: quick freeform questions and micro-experiments for control-owner mapping before I formalize the control matrix. Not polished — dump of thoughts, links, gaps.

Topline goals
- Identify single-source owner for each control family (identity, logging, change mgmt, infra config)
- Capture obvious cross-team handoffs (who signs off on backups, who owns key rotation)
- Surface ambiguous items to raise in trust sync next Wed

Quick notes / observations
- Serving runtime: lots of infra-level controls (change mgmt, deployment approvals, RBAC). Primary owner likely eng-infra + SRE, but product owners sometimes trigger infra changes. Need explicit decision: "infra owns enforcement; product owns change requests"?
- Private deployments: mix of sales/solutions + eng-private. Controls around customer data isolation probably belong to solutions-eng + security. Need to list 3 evidences we can produce today (design doc, customer VLAN config, SOC2 checklist snippet).
- Key management: KMS/HSM integration exists but gaps in rotation evidence. Who has rotation schedule? Security or infra? I think security owns policy; infra executes rotations and provides logs.

Open questions (to resolve or file as tickets)
- Q1: Who is canonical owner of "access reviews" for service accounts used by batch inference? (eng-serving-runtime? sre?)
- Q2: What existing artifact satisfies CC6.1 change approval? Is it a PR template + review checklist or separate ticket in Jira?
- Q3: For backup/restore testing (control evidence), do we have an annual runbook test or only ad-hoc restores? Need dates/examples.
- Q4: Does Dedicated capacity onboarding include a documented client-side network diagram that we can attach as evidence? If not, can Solutions produce one?
- Q5: Are there automated alerts for KV-cache size anomalies (potential DoS/availability control)? If yes, where are the alert flares stored?

Quick checklist (what I can do before trust sync)
- [x] Pull latest control inventory CSV (from Confluence page) — file dated 2026-02-12
- [ ] Export audit logs for last 90 days for production serving clusters (ask SRE for retained bucket path)
- [ ] Identify 3 sample PRs showing change mgmt flow for model rollout (candidate owners: release-engineering, serving-runtime)
- [ ] Draft short owner matrix: control family -> owner -> backup owner -> evidence list
- [ ] Collect KB link for KMS procedures (ask Ellie if there is a consolidated doc)

Evidence sketches (things I might attach)
- PR + approval chain for kerberized deployment to Dedicated pool (PR 3287 might work)
- Slack thread + ops runbook for a recent rollback (Feb 2026) — shows incident plus RCA
- Backup manifest + restore timestamp for small customer dataset (sanitized)
- IAM policy snapshot + last modified date for production service-role

Mapping heuristics I'm proposing (to discuss)
- Ownership = team that can produce operational evidence without cross-team escalation in < 3 business days
- Backup owner = team that both creates backups and can demonstrate restore path (if not same as primary owner, list both)
- Audit evidence = logs stored in central bucket with indexable prefix + retention policy reference

Draft owner matrix (very rough)
- Identity & Access Management: primary = security, secondary = eng-infra
- Change Management (deployments, model rollouts): primary = release-engineering, secondary = serving-runtime
- Logging & Monitoring: primary = observability, secondary = site-reliability-engineering
- Customer Data Isolation (Private): primary = solutions-engineering, secondary = security
- Key Management: primary = security, secondary = infra-ops

Potential short-term asks for SRE/Infra (to file as small tickets)
- Ticket: export list of service-accounts + last-used timestamps (for access review) — target owner: eng-infra
- Ticket: provide 90d raw audit log export for prod-serving clusters — owner: sre
- Ticket: snapshot of IAM roles for "production-serving" namespace with last_modified field — owner: infra-iam

Meeting notes to capture next sync (bullet prompts)
- Confirm owner definitions and accept heuristics above
- Prioritize 5 controls to produce definitive evidence for pilot (ideally low-effort: access review, IAM snapshot, 90d logs, 2 PRs, one restore runbook)
- Agree on ticket owners for short-term asks and deadlines (prefer <2 weeks)

Random scribbles / reminders
- check PR 2310 (platform) for references to RBAC migration — might be good evidence if merged by Mar
- call out dedicated onboarding diagram as missing artifact for Private
- remember to ask Solutions for customer-facing templates (we can sanitize)

Next steps (my personal TODO)
- Mar 03: triage responses from Ava & Lena; update matrix
- Mar 05: create 5 tickets in Jira (JIRA project: TRUST) based on short-term asks
- Mar 09: prep a 1-page handout listing owners + evidence locations for trust sync

Notes-to-self: keep this doc informal. Move final matrix into Confluence once owners agree.
